note: Everything Blackwell Engine Native 1.3.1 is built from, pinned. Order: extract wine, apply highball patches-arm64 (all, sorted), apply patches-arm64-xbox/0100 to 0105 in order, run engine/build-native.sh, then engine/package-native.sh with the three Highball archives below.

blackwell-xbox-patch.from: engine/patches 0001, 0002, 0004, 0006 to 0009 and 0012, ported to Wine 11.18; 0003 (macOS %gs TEB slots) and 0005 (x86-64 exception traces) are x86-64 only and left out; 0008's concurrent_vector hunks are upstream in 11.18; its concurrent queue iterator (which Forza Horizon 6 calls: FHE01 without it, issue #14) is ported since Native 1.1
blackwell-xbox-patch.online: engine/patches-arm64-xbox/0101-ntdll-dualstack-ipv4-options.patch since Native 1.2: prsloan's dual-stack socket fix from highball-engine pull request #40 (their arm64 0059, LGPL-2.1-or-later), so Forza Horizon 6 keeps its UDP game socket and joins online sessions (engine/patches/ORIGIN-online.md)
blackwell-xbox-patch.controllers: engine/patches-arm64-xbox/0102-gameinput-xinput-pads-as-xbox.patch since Native 1.2: every pad GameInput reports through XInput is an Xbox One controller to the game (issue #15: a DualSense seen as connected that did nothing); WINE_GAMEINPUT_REAL_IDS=1 keeps their own ids
blackwell-xbox-patch.store: engine/patches-arm64-xbox/0103-xgameruntime-store-ownership-gamer-picture.patch since Native 1.3: the add-ons the account owns, their licences and the account's own gamer picture, from xodus-service (issue #18); what the game got before whenever the service cannot answer
blackwell-xbox-patch.pads: engine/patches-arm64-xbox/0104-gameinput-controller-ui-navigation-and-macos-pads.patch since Native 1.3: a pad is also a generic controller and a UI navigation device, as Windows reports an Xbox pad, and when XInput has no pad the pads macOS knows are read through GameController.framework (a PlayStation pad on Bluetooth, issue #15); WINE_GAMEINPUT_APPLE=0 turns that source off
blackwell-xbox-patch.dispatcher: engine/patches-arm64-xbox/0105-gameinput-dispatcher.patch since Native 1.3.1: IGameInputDispatcher, so a game can run GameInput's callbacks itself, as on Windows (issue #15)

highball-engine-r4.takes: FEX (xtajit64.dll, xtajit.dll, lib*fex.so), winegstreamer, engine/lib host libraries, Wine Mono and Gecko, frameworks/

loader.note: Not in the bundle: MetalHorizon installs it from Highball's release and checks its signature (components.json, wineloader).
